influences.name: Nick Cave
influences.context: I was watching a Nick Cave interview the other day where he was saying that, you know, there's only three sort — there's only three topics.

influences.name: Vince Clarke
influences.context: VCMG, because this is [Martin] collaborating with Vince Clarke, an original member of Depeche Mode... doing the VCMG project meant that I was focused on doing something completely different for a long period. Which meant that when I actually came back to writing songs I felt more inspired.
